name: NRE 4697W
title: Undergraduate Research Thesis in Natural Resources
description: Writing of a formal thesis based on independent research conducted by the student. Thesis proposal and final thesis must follow guidelines developed by the Department; and be submitted to, and approved by, a department review committee.
requirement_description: Three credits of either NRE 3699 or 4696, which may be taken concurrently; ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; open to juniors or higher; open only with consent of instructor.
